caption: A person standing on one leg wobbles, sways further, and puts the other foot down to stay upright.

sa.check: A person stands on one leg.
They put the other foot down.
The sway comes first and the foot comes down after.

pc.expect: The sway grows before the foot comes down, and the foot lands on the side the body was leaning toward.
pc.fail: The foot lands on the other side; or they fall over; or they stay perfectly still.

pc.expect: The sway stops after the foot lands.
pc.fail: They keep swaying after; or the sway stops before the foot is down; or they jump.

pc.expect: The foot lands on the ground.
pc.fail: It sinks; or hovers above the ground while they steady; or passes through.

pc.expect: The body bends at the joints.
pc.fail: It folds mid-bone; or a limb detaches; or a leg stretches.

pc.expect: Their limbs keep their number and stay attached.
pc.fail: A limb vanishes; or a third leg appears; or a second figure appears.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: Their clothing and the floor stay the same.
pc.fail: The clothing changes colour; or the floor changes; or the room rearranges.

note: Biomechanics scene: the body is the physics. Form, posture and skill are not judged; only that limbs stay attached, bend at joints, keep ground contact and pass through nothing.
